findings.description: Internal object replacements bypass the settings draft guard. Selecting another MCP server or removal clears the current edit; selecting another remote share unmounts SharedDetails and drops unsaved audience/recipients; provider selection and provider revision changes remount ModelCatalog and drop its separately registered manual-model/capability edits. Outer settings navigation protection does not guard these transitions.
findings.reproduction: Edit MCP server A then select B or remove; switch back to A and the edits are lost without consent. Edit shared object A recipients then choose B and return to A. Add unsaved manual catalog rows for provider A then select another provider or allow a registry revision change. The children are replaced under a new key; their settings draft registrations do not prevent replacement.
findings.recommendation: Preserve or explicitly confirm discarding edits before internal user-selected target changes. Distinguish an acknowledged submitted revision from later edits when refreshing registry/model data, and keep old async results quarantined by owner/revision. Do not retain secrets or authorization across identity loss.
findings.validation: Full source control-flow and test assertion review; existing tests guard outer exits and scope changes but lack these internal transitions. No new test execution during freeze.

findings.description: The retire confirmation button repeats the entire warning paragraph after the word Confirm, instead of a short action label. The same warning is already displayed directly above. This creates an excessively tall, wrapping mobile action and an unwieldy accessible name.
findings.reproduction: Open Worktrees, select a ready clean worktree and select Retire: the button includes the full retention/archive/irreversibility warning as its label.
findings.recommendation: Use a concise confirmation label such as 确认退役工作树 while retaining the existing warning paragraph, exact revision binding and confirmation checkbox.
findings.validation: Read JSX branch and responsive/button styles cross-review; no browser layout measurement claimed.

delegatedCoverage.description: Root independently content-reviewed 30 named frontend tests and all 14 root styles/entry/config/favicon files. These are not included in this reviewer inspectedFiles.
Web/runtime cross-reviewer content-reviewed nine workspace/git/project tests (2623 lines), no findings. Those files are not included in this reviewer inspectedFiles.

method: Read the complete current contents of every frontend TS/TSX component, hook and library, relevant shared browser helpers, and the remaining frontend tests/fixtures. Followed state ownership, generations, pending-operation acceptance, dirty-editor registration, internal and outer navigation, model/connection/revision isolation, conversion source/destination independence, local receipt persistence, terminal/realtime cleanup, media/privacy, keyboard/focus and mobile control semantics. Tests were reviewed for actual assertions and fixture behavior, not titles or inventory alone. The read ledger records full line coverage for 184 files; 16 additional manually read files are listed explicitly. Source inventory and digest were verified at entry and completion. Root and sibling supplemental reports cover the disjoint 53 frontend files, without claiming those were personally reviewed here.
observations: Terminal tests exercise early output ordering, bounded queueing, positive receipts after HTTP loss, original operation-only recovery, original-project close without adopting a different owner, stale connection fencing, unknown launch no replay, CLI/cloud epoch refresh and explicit shell closure.

Realtime tests exercise microphone permission cancellation, owner and ABA replacements, monotonic frame sequences, newer draft preservation, no replay of unknown frames, independently retained cleanup receipts, stale callbacks and StrictMode effect replay.

Model/provider and input tests verify catalog identity, shared directory updates, inherited effort choices, explicit conversion with immutable source, original model quarantine, multimodal/context ownership and exact revision acknowledgements.
Settings draft review found the reported remaining internal replacement gap; outer navigation and extension project change guards now cover full1 issue.
Root independently found MFA readSession contract mismatch and a frontend UTF-8 limit regression gap; those are recorded in its report and are not duplicated here.
limitations: Static semantic audit only; this frozen round did not execute tests, access live production or perform real browser device rendering.

Generated web/dist assets are build outputs and were not treated as editable source. Native services, actual provider/model/MCP calls, media devices and real mobile viewport behavior require separate targeted or full-suite evidence.
The workspace-search fixture title mentions project changes but only changes query; it is not counted as an independent project-change test.
